score: maximum reported similarity among references with exactly matching peptide; no hit -> 0 (abstention tie), not binding probability
reference: Existing original raw VDJdb snapshot; HomoSapiens, gene TRB, confidence >=2, canonical CDR3; queried peptide panel only
family_exclusion: remove reference CDR3s if any query has >=90% SequenceMatcher ratio and length ratio >=90%; exact matches also excluded; CDR3beta screen is not full paired receptor family proof
missing_prediction_policy: all 10000 original observations retained; no-hit pairs score 0
ci_scope: descriptive per-peptide metrics only; no independent study or clinical CI
binary_installation: compile unmodified pinned source in temporary directory with existing g++; no package install
